text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Osaka Hai, the spring
G1 race
that always draws the strongest
competitors...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! The fans are getting really
excited, aren't
they?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm super pumped too,
because I'm
going to be running with
Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wanna find out just how strong
someone called
"the Emperor" really is!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, there's no speed limit on the turf!
It's top
gear or nothing!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Spe. You're supposed to
stay quiet in
the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys! You came all the way to
Hanshin
to see the race?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I wanted to see you run with my
own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Getting ready for the Yasuda Kinen, are
you? In
that case, I'll have to give it all
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll be rooting for you too, so do your
best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can't look bad in front of these
beloved
little students!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll give them an amazing race that
proves I'm
worthy of being chased after!
